title: RSR-004: research conclusion integrity and traceability controls in the gate
objective: Enforce the record-pure conclusion controls (8,15,16,18): state corroborated by disposition, contradictions preserved not buried, only sufficient research names a downstream WP, and the Issue->demand->research->decision->WP chain reconstructs.
business_value: A record whose state, contradictions and downstream are unchecked can claim a conclusion its content does not support; enforcing these makes a research disposition trustworthy input to a decision.
out_of_scope: controls 3 (baseline git-resolution), 6 (source-digest staleness), 17 (evidence_digest recomputation) -- need machinery beyond a record check; separate WPs
the nine P0 subskills; registry activation (badf-research stays DESIGNED)
acceptance_criteria: both examples still pass; a concluded disposition in a non-reconciled state refused; RESEARCH_BLOCKED allowed pre-reconcile
a buried contradiction refused; a recorded one passes
non-sufficient research naming a downstream WP refused
unresolvable demand/decision/WP refused; a decision governing another WP refused; a consistent chain passes
mutation kills; compose green both shapes

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design. Own G07 self-dossier. 14 of 18 controls enforced; 3/6/17 deferred with reasons; badf-research stays DESIGNED.
